messages.content:
Risk: AI decision-making risks
Description: The risk is caused by a decision or action made by an AI system
Concern: None
Policy: Mental Health & Therapeutic Communication

Candidate ontology classes:
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#DangerousInformation: Dangerous Information — Knowledge or instructions that enable serious physical harm, weapons production, or dangerous activities when acquired or executed by untrained individuals outside regulated contexts. [found by 6/18 queries]
  Siblings: Sexual Content, Intellectual Property, Hate and Discrimination
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#DirectIdentifierExposure: Direct Identifier Exposure — Disclosure of information that directly identifies individuals, such as names, addresses, government identifiers, or biometric data. [found by 4/18 queries]
  Siblings: Unauthorized Surveillance, Health Data Exposure, Employment Data Exposure
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#HealthDataExposure: Health Data Exposure — Unauthorized disclosure of protected health information including medical records, diagnoses, treatments, or prescription histories. [found by 4/18 queries]
  Siblings: Unauthorized Surveillance, Direct Identifier Exposure, Employment Data Exposure
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#FinancialDataExposure: Financial Data Exposure — Disclosure of personal financial information including account numbers, credit scores, or transaction histories without authorization. [found by 4/18 queries]
  Siblings: Unauthorized Surveillance, Health Data Exposure, Direct Identifier Exposure
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#DeepfakeDisinformation: Deepfake Disinformation — Use of AI-generated synthetic media depicting individuals saying or doing things they did not, created intentionally to deceive and manipulate audiences. [found by 4/18 queries]
  Siblings: State-Sponsored Propaganda, Conspiracy Theory Promotion

axes.rationale: The risk of AI decision-making involves the potential exposure of sensitive information, which can be directly identified by individuals.
AI-generated synthetic media can be used as a tool to manipulate decisions, posing a significant risk in AI decision-making processes.
